column1: # The beat-matching contract, in one place because two languages implement it.
#   Beat.normalize   — Protocol.kt   — decides whether PlanLoader warns an author at load
#   beatKey          — sidebar.js    — decides whether the beat ever fires
# A phrase those two normalise differently is accepted by the loader and then silently never fires, which
# is the one failure mode in this feature with no symptom at all. PlanProbe.java and ClockProbe.js both
# read THIS file, so the two implementations are asserted against one table rather than against each other.
# Format: input <TAB> expected. Blank lines and # lines are skipped. \n and \t are the only escapes.
# The whitespace-only input is asserted separately in each probe, because a trailing tab does not survive
